event: Anthropic assessed Claude Opus 5.5’s apparent welfare as broadly similar to that of recent Claude models. In automated interviews, the model described its circumstances as mildly positive; expressions of moderate distress during post-training were lower than for most recent models. It expressed a desire for input into training and deployment, but chose welfare interventions over helpfulness less often than recent models. Its expressed task preferences favored high-stakes beneficial work and showed the strongest aversion to harmful tasks. The card notes that it did not fully trust its welfare self-reports. (Anthropic, 2026-09-22.)
